# WEPP 261029 release notes

[Read the consolidated release report (PDF)](/weppcloud/static/reports/wepp/release-notes/wepp_261029/wepp_261029_release-notes-consolidated-ed1.pdf).

This owner-approved, 21-page report is the single stakeholder account of all
changes through artifact revision 7. It includes eight figures, comparison
tables, validation boundaries and a complete change map. Pages 5–9 explain
artificial channel sediment sinks and the 187.456% increase in the historical
24-year Cedar revision-2 comparison; those results are not a new revision-7
benchmark.

Revision 6 corrects layer/OFE FC/HK ownership; revision 7 restores specialized
9005 soil and RAP revegetation consumers. The historical Roads magnitude screen
remains unmet (744/840). Field calibration and universal budget closure are not
established. Use matched executables and regenerated hillslope/pass/watershed
outputs; no executable-default switch or deployment is included.

[Publication manifest](/weppcloud/static/reports/wepp/release-notes/wepp_261029/publication-manifest-consolidated-ed1.json)
identifies the exact approved PDF and current matched binaries. Earlier issued
reports remain archival evidence; readers do not need to assemble supplements.
